metadata.title: UFAS1 Faculty of Medicine — 1st Year Medicine Knowledge Base
metadata.important_note: Student experiences must not be presented as official rules. Time-sensitive academic information should be verified against the latest official faculty documents.

pre_clinical.description: The first two years mainly study the normal state of the human body, its composition and functioning. The third year is described as a transition between pre-clinical and clinical cycles.

clinical.description: Clinical years are described as being organized using a modular system.

first_year.language_note: Other modules may use a mixture of French and English.

question_types.QCS: Question à choix simple; one correct answer
question_types.QCM: Question à choix multiple; multiple options may be correct

tout_ou_rien.description: All correct options must be selected; an additional or missing option results in zero.

partiel.description: An incomplete correct answer receives partial credit; an incorrect option results in zero.

partiel_ameliore_positif.description: An incomplete correct answer receives partial credit; an incorrect option can reduce the score.

assessment.strategy_note: Students should know the correction system before the exam and avoid selecting options they are not confident about.

perceived_advantages: Students describe the theoretical teaching as strong.
Some teachers are described as competent and supportive.
Previous exams and educational resources are available.
perceived_difficulties: Large student numbers can make practical activities more difficult.
A high student-to-hospital capacity ratio is reported as a practical challenge.
Some students report significant stress around assessments.
French and English may both be used.
student_experience.labeling_rule: These are student perceptions and must not be presented as official institutional facts.

ai_retrieval_rules.exam_prediction_rule: Never guarantee that a question will appear on an exam. Say that a topic or question was reported as recurrent only when supported by the source.
